AC repair, service and installation in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar
Summers in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) are hot and dusty, and an AC that struggles in April or May makes life miserable. Most AC problems start small: a clogged filter, a blocked drain, a weak capacitor. Catching them early costs less than waiting for a breakdown.
AC repair: when your AC is already giving trouble
If your AC is not cooling, leaking water, making noise or refusing to start, you need a repair visit, not a routine service. Our technician checks the unit, finds the cause and tells you the cost before starting. See our AC repair page for the faults we handle.
AC service: before trouble starts
A yearly AC service cleans the filters and coils, checks the drain, electrical parts and gas pressure, and tests cooling. Book it before summer. If your AC runs most of the day, every six months is sensible.
AC deep cleaning: when a normal service is not enough
If the AC smells musty or airflow stays weak after a service, jet pump deep cleaning washes the coils and blower properly. Not sure which you need? Read deep cleaning vs normal service.
AC installation: get it right the first time
Poor installation causes weak cooling, noise and leaks. We fit split and window units and shift existing ACs, with proper mounting, piping, drain and a test run. Details on AC installation.
Washing machine and refrigerator repair in Aurangabad
We also repair front-load and top-load washing machines (not draining, not spinning, noise, leaks) and refrigerators (weak cooling, frost, noise, water on the floor).
Looking for AC repair near you? We visit homes across Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) and nearby areas. Call +91 95798 68696 or message us on WhatsApp.

Frequently asked questions
What causes an AC to stop cooling?
Common causes are dirty filters or coils, low refrigerant from a leak, a failing capacitor or compressor, and a faulty sensor or PCB. A technician needs to inspect the unit to confirm which.
How often should an AC be serviced?
Once a year at minimum, ideally before summer. Heavily used ACs, or ACs in dusty areas, benefit from servicing every six months.
How much does AC repair cost in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar?
It depends on the fault and the parts. A clean or capacitor change costs far less than a compressor or PCB replacement. We inspect first and tell you the cost before any repair starts.
Who provides AC service near me in Aurangabad?
Urban Repair Company provides AC service at your home in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) and nearby areas. Call +91 95798 68696 to book.
Do you repair washing machines, refrigerators and other appliances?
Yes. We repair washing machines and refrigerators, and can look at other home appliances. Call with the appliance and fault to confirm.
Which areas of Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar do you serve?
We serve Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) and nearby areas. Call +91 95798 68696 to confirm service in your locality.
How long does AC servicing take?
A routine service of one split AC usually takes around an hour, depending on the unit's condition. We confirm timing when you book.
How much does AC installation cost?
It depends on the AC type, pipe length, wall type and mounting needs. We quote after seeing the site or the details you share.
Why is my AC leaking water?
Most often a blocked drain line, or a coil frozen from dirty filters. A technician should clear the drain and check the unit.
Is AC deep cleaning worth it?
Yes, if the AC smells, airflow stays weak after a service, or it has not been cleaned for years. Otherwise a yearly service is enough.
Do I need to be at home for the visit?
Yes, someone should be present to show us the appliance and approve the repair estimate.
Do you give a warranty on repairs?
Yes. Our repairs carry a 120-day unconditional warranty.
Do you offer same-day service?
Yes, same-day service is available. Call or WhatsApp us to confirm timing for your area.
How much does AC gas refilling cost in Aurangabad?

Our repairs carry a 120-day unconditional warranty. Ask our team for the details of your repair when you book.

URL: https://theurbanrepaircompany.com/ac-gas-refill-chhatrapati-sambhajinagar

AC Gas Refilling in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad)
Last updated: 25 October 2026
Quick answer: Urban Repair Company finds and repairs AC gas leaks, then refills and tests in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad). We inspect first, quote upfront and start work only after you approve. Same-day service is available, genuine spare parts are used, and repairs carry a 120-day unconditional warranty. Call +91 95798 68696.
AC gas does not get used up like fuel. If your AC is low on refrigerant, there is almost always a leak. We find the leak, repair it, then refill and test, so the cooling lasts.
A top-up without fixing the leak only lasts a few weeks. Our technician confirms the cause, explains it and quotes the cost before work starts.

AC Gas Refilling FAQs
How much does ac gas refilling cost in Aurangabad?
It depends on aC type; refrigerant used; whether a leak repair is needed. We inspect first, quote upfront and start work only after you approve.
How do I know if my AC needs gas?
Weak cooling, ice on the pipe or an oily joint are common signs. Only an inspection can confirm it.
Why does AC gas run out?
It does not get used up. A low level means a leak, which should be repaired before refilling.

## FAQ | Urban Repair Company
URL: https://theurbanrepaircompany.com/faq

Frequently asked questions
Last updated: 25 October 2026
What causes an AC to stop cooling?
Common causes are dirty filters or coils, low refrigerant from a leak, a failing capacitor or compressor, and a faulty sensor or PCB. A technician must inspect the unit to confirm which.
How much does AC repair cost?
It depends on the fault and parts. Cleaning or a capacitor change costs far less than a compressor or PCB replacement. We give an estimate after inspection, before any work.
How often should an AC be serviced?
At least once a year, ideally before summer. Heavily used ACs or ACs in dusty areas benefit from servicing every six months.
How long does AC servicing take?
A routine service of one split AC typically takes around an hour, depending on the unit's condition. Confirm timing when you book.
How much does AC installation cost?
The cost depends on unit type, pipe length and mounting needs. We give an estimate after seeing the site or the details you share.
Do you install both split and window ACs?
Yes.
What does AC maintenance include?
Cleaning, electrical and gas checks, and inspection of moving parts, repeated on a schedule that suits your usage.
What is the difference between AC deep cleaning and a normal service?
A normal service cleans filters and checks the unit. Deep cleaning washes the coils and blower with pressurised water to remove built-up dirt.
Do you repair washing machines?
Yes, front-load and top-load machines.
Why is my washing machine not draining?
Common causes are a blocked filter or hose, a failed drain pump or a control fault.
Do you provide refrigerator repair?
Yes.
Why is my refrigerator not cooling?
Possible causes include a failing compressor or relay, a blocked or frosted coil, a faulty thermostat or a refrigerant leak.
Do you repair fridges at home?
Yes, at your home in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad).
Do you provide home appliance repair?
Yes for many appliances. Call us with the appliance type and brand to confirm.
How do I know if my AC needs gas?
Weak cooling, ice on the pipe or an oily joint are common signs. Only an inspection can confirm it.
Why does AC gas run out?
It does not get used up. A low level means a leak, which should be repaired before refilling.
Do you give a warranty?
Yes. Our repairs carry a 120-day unconditional warranty.
Is same-day service available?
Yes. Call or WhatsApp us and we will confirm the earliest slot for your area.
Do you use genuine spare parts?
Yes. We use genuine spare parts.
How much does AC gas refilling cost in Aurangabad?
It depends on the AC type, the refrigerant and whether a leak must be repaired first. We inspect, find the cause and quote before any work.
What does the 120-day unconditional warranty cover?
Our repairs carry a 120-day unconditional warranty. Ask our team for the details of your repair when you book.
Do you serve areas outside the city?
We serve Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad) and nearby areas. Call or WhatsApp us with your location to confirm.
Need it fixed today?
Same-day service available. We inspect first and quote upfront.
